mainText: Good morning. It's Thursday, October 29. Stocks are pointing lower this morning. The S and P 500 is down about two tenths of a percent, the Dow is down about a tenth, and the Nasdaq 100 is down about one percent. An Alphabet earnings miss is weighing on tech, and the Federal Reserve held rates steady at 3.75 to 4 percent yesterday. The 10-year Treasury yield is about 5.01 percent, down a few basis points from yesterday's close. Big premarket movers: Alphabet down 10 percent after its miss. Microsoft up 2 percent. Fortinet down 26 percent and ServiceNow down 19 percent. DoorDash up 5 to 9 percent on its Instacart buy. Marvell down 11 percent while Lumentum is up 5 and a half percent on deal news. Crocs up 18 percent. Caterpillar down 9 percent. Eli Lilly up 4 and a half percent. Chipotle up 7 percent. eBay up 6 percent.
